scope: Part 15B application-command metadata, leaf option schemas, submitted interaction options and resolved references; no comprehensive source or entire-platform parity claim.
reviewedContracts: Explicit API v10 remains the latest available HTTP API version in the reference.
Slash definitions preserve source order, at most 25 options, required-before-optional ordering, unique names and existing model validation.
Integer arguments admit exact -9007199254740991 through 9007199254740991; number arguments admit finite values from -9007199254740992 through 9007199254740992.
Interaction leaf values and nested options are mutually exclusive; focused partial autocomplete input is outside manual slash invocation decoding.
Resolved references remain partial local snapshots, preserve exact snowflake IDs and require no resource hydration.
Attachment file_types filters remain supported through the existing validated model; matching file extensions never establishes file contents.
knownGaps: Subcommands/groups, autocomplete routes, remaining command families, macros, response families, policies and supervised HTTP/Gateway hosts remain separately planned.
qualification: Fetched-source hashes identify the exact local review inputs; no upstream introduction date is inferred and no live Discord request or independent conformance qualification is claimed.
